title: DPDPAEvent
description: A single unit of telemetry ingested from an organisation's source system (log line or API payload). This schema is frozen after Phase 0 — do not modify without a full team review.

tenant_id.description: The organisation this event belongs to. Must match a registered org_id in the Org Config store. All downstream partitioning (registry lookups, Evidence Store, dashboard) is scoped by this value. IMMUTABLE after ingestion.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event. Format: UUID v4.

source_type.description: Whether this event originated from an application log line or an API request/response payload.

source_system.description: The microservice or system that emitted this event, as defined by the org's config (source_system is a free-form string, not a fixed enum — valid values are whatever the org declares in their Org Config fields). Used by auditors to break down violations by system.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was emitted by the source system.

raw_snippet.description: The raw log line or API payload string as received. Used for audit evidence and human review. Must never be modified after ingestion.

fields.description: Extracted key-value pairs from the raw_snippet. Keys are field names (e.g. 'phone', 'apaar_id'); values are the corresponding raw values. Open map — different source systems carry different fields.
